request.scope: Zero-cost written commercial-use permission for existing Roderic narration and future Roderic generations on HeyGen Free plan; no subscription or billing changes requested.

providerDetermination.applicableTerms: HeyGen Terms of Service Section 4 (Free Plan) and Voice Supplemental Terms Section 6, as quoted by HeyGen Support in its written response.
providerDetermination.summary: HeyGen Support explicitly stated that it cannot grant a zero-cost commercial-use exception for Free-plan users, for existing or future narration. The existing and future Free-plan outputs are restricted to personal, non-commercial and internal evaluation; public branded distribution and commercial use are not permitted.

nextRequiredAction: A commercially licensed voice would require a paid plan, which is outside the user's zero-cost constraint. Do not substitute another voice without explicit owner approval. The Roderic-only production preference and zero-cost constraint therefore create an external rights blocker; no compliant production narration is currently available.
